name: Mathematical defect
about: Report the earliest exact failing mathematical step
title: "[Defect] "
labels: mathematics, verification
assignees: ''
---

## Location

Please identify the earliest exact location in the manuscript or replay material.

## Claimed failure

State the identity, implication, estimate, sign, quantifier, symmetry step, chain-rule step, Sturm/enclosure step, or hypothesis boundary that you believe fails.

## Reproduction

Provide the shortest explicit calculation, counterexample, or exact citation needed to reproduce the objection.

## Scope

Please distinguish between:
- mathematical error;
- prior-art / novelty issue;
- exposition ambiguity;
- implementation/replay issue;
- claim-boundary issue.

General assessments are less useful than a minimal reproducible objection.---
